title: About Me
headline: Coding and being creative is my life! I love to learn, create and experiment both at work and at home.

sections.title: Before College
items: Became interested in coding as a child writing simple Vic-20 games by altering examples I found in computer magazines
Taught myself procedural coding by reverse engineering the Gorillas game for QBasic
Learned 3D Studio 4.0 (Dos) with a buddy and started making pre-rendered games in Turing a year before Donkey Kong Country
Built a fully playable RPG (similar to Dragon Warrior) as my high school Computer Science project and the teacher didn't understand how to play it...
Created software used for a hospital's psychology test (QBasic)
Built a finished Mario themed version of Tetris in C++/Assembly

sections.title: College (3 year Computer Engineering at Humber)
items: Programmed the Motorola 68HC11 micro-controller to control a robot that could solve a maze
Built a custom assembly language and CPU emulator
Built a custom UDP protocol and markup language for a mock intranet web browser
Worked with custom printer, serial port and mouse drivers

sections.title: Professional Experience
items: Led a team of 7 using tools such as Visio, UML, Asana, Basecamp, Beanstalk SVN, Hyjoki, Waterfall, Agile
Wrote the SR&ED claims from 2006 - 2011
Created semi programmable scripting language incorporating BNF Grammar
Created XML GUI layout managers before JavaFX and Silverlight
Taught OOD to jr developers by illustrating the 3D pipeline in software
Built software for LANs supported on Windows NT, Windows Server, Macintosh Server, Novell 4 - 6
Built two networkable custom ISAM Btree databases + API's
Worked mainly with Java SE 1 - 6, JNI, XMLRPC, JNLP, C#, PHP, SQL, JDBC, AWS, LAMP, Shell Scripts
Other projects using C++, Python, ASP.NET, SQL Server with stored procedures, Servlets, Ant
Last 6 years have been MEAN(MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node), Bootstrap, HTML5, CSS3, Canvas, JQuery
Last 3 years have been React, Redux, Django, AWS Lambda, CSS Grid, Flexbox, Spine

sections.title: Side Companies
items: Square Particle Corp - Created a gaming company and released games for Android, WP7, Xbox 360, BlackBerry and PC
Square Particle Corp - Coauthored seven Sci-fi books
CD Software Developers - Formed a business with several partners/investors to create software to be distributed by funeral homes (VB.NET, OLE, ODBC)
Scary Pixel - Worked with a partner to build a working prototype for a bid on a Tim Hortons contract (C#, Java)

sections.title: Indie Projects
items: Built a 2D gaming framework similar to Unity (Cross-platform, Cross language, Custom Scripting, WYSIWYG interface)
Participated in four 48 hour Game Jams and one 30 day Game Jam
Created complete game engines in C++, Direct X 5 - 9c, Java, Open GL 1 - 2, MDX, JadEngine, LWJGL, LibGDX and XNA
Shortly after the release of Minecraft, I created my own procedural Voxel engine
Created a XAML like 3D game engine with networking capabilities
To learn Unity, I decided to partner with an asset creator and develop GUI tools for building maze like games
Now I am working on a Oculus/Gear VR game Called Bridge Captain

items: 100k+ Flag Hunt players (Featured in Germany)
10,000's of school children use the software I created daily
Santa's Route was featured three times on AppsLib
Santa's Route was on the Daily Planet Website

My work has brought my employer large returns for over a decade from SR&ED (Scientific Research and Experimental Development) and OMDC (Ontario Media Development Corporation)
Building games with my kids in GameMaker, RPG Maker and JavaScript :)
